name: plex-language-sync
description: Remembers the audio and subtitle languages you pick for each TV show in Plex and sets them on every other episode, for each user of your server. Sets your choice on the rest of the show as soon as you pick it on one episode, and gives new episodes the same tracks when Plex adds them. It learns which subtitles you pair with each audio language and sets them on new shows. It chooses between the tracks your files already have and downloads nothing. No web UI, no open port.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent cache of learned language profiles, shared-user tokens and sync state

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator. Plex's guide: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

variables.name: Update level
variables.description: Scope of language propagation: show applies to all episodes of the show, season only to the current season

variables.name: Update strategy
variables.description: Which episodes to update: all updates every episode in scope, next only the episodes after the one being played

variables.name: Trigger on play
variables.description: React to playback events: playing an episode propagates its language settings

variables.name: Trigger on scan
variables.description: React to library scans: newly added or updated episodes get each user's recorded selection for the show

variables.name: Learn language profiles
variables.description: Learn audio-to-subtitle language pairs from playback and apply them to brand new shows with no watch history

variables.name: Subtitle match tier
variables.description: How far a subtitle substitution may reach when no exact language match exists: identical, same-language, other-region, other-script, intelligible or shared-literacy

variables.name: Deep scan interval
variables.description: How often the deep-scan safety net runs, as a Go duration such as 24h or 12h. off turns it off

variables.name: Ignore labels
variables.description: Comma-separated Plex labels that exclude a show from language sync. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, and setting this replaces the defaults

variables.name: Ignore libraries
variables.description: Comma-separated Plex library names to exclude entirely. Matching is exact and case-sensitive

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error. debug shows why each event was skipped and how streams were matched

variables.name: Plex CA certificate path
variables.description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate. The path of the CA PEM file inside the container, with a matching path mapping
